integrity: All counts refer to ordered commuting pairs; experimental checks are separate from the orbit decomposition proof.
scientific_limitations: Only regular actions of elementary abelian two-groups. The full Boolean semidirect product and zero-collapsed partial translation monoid must be distinguished. The checker covers sizes two, four and eight, while the proof covers all positive ranks. Historical equivalents remain possible.
title: Exact commutativity in Boolean translation inverse monoids of elementary two-groups
